title: SPC Vinyl vs. Carpet and Tile for Central Florida Homes
metaTitle: SPC Vinyl vs. Carpet and Tile for Central Florida Homes
contentHtml:
If your carpet is worn or your old floor is tired, you're probably weighing your options. Here's a plain look at how the choices compare in a Central Florida home.

What worn carpet costs you here

Florida heat and humidity are hard on carpet. It holds moisture, it traps dust and pet odors, and it wears out faster in the traffic areas. Many homeowners replace it sooner than they planned.

What SPC rigid-core vinyl plank is

SPC stands for stone polymer composite. Our Duralast SPC planks have a rigid core. They're built to handle the everyday wear of a busy household, and they look like real wood or stone in a range of colors.

SPC works well in:

  • Kitchens, entryways, and hallways
  • Family rooms and bedrooms
  • Homes where spills and pets are part of daily life

Where tile fits

Tile is a strong choice for bathrooms and shower walls, and we install it with clean lines and tight grout joints. For a full-home floor, though, many homeowners find SPC easier to live with: it's warmer underfoot than tile and quieter to walk on.

Compare samples in your own home

Swatches in a showroom can look different from the same color in your living room. That's why we bring Duralast samples to your home for a free in-home measure. You can see how the color works with your light, your walls, and your furniture before you decide.

You can also preview our floors on our website.
